open_wedge_witness.meaning: Observed exact-substitution relation need not be transitive; absent A-C evidence is not proof of incompatibility.
open_wedge_witness.selection: Largest minimum arm frame-count, then total arm frame-count; deterministic lexical tie-break.

protocol.cooccurrence: Both distinct signs anywhere in the same complete text, counted once per pair/text, with all occurrence positions retained.
protocol.edge: Two distinct W signs fill exactly the same single masked position in complete texts of equal length.
protocol.input: Existing strict complete single-line direction-marked transcription subset; filtering inherited from prepare_corpora.py.
limits: Exact shared contexts do not establish sound, meaning, grammatical class or allography.
Missing edges may reflect sparse data, selection or transcription, not impossibility.
Open-wedge closure is a graph operation, not evidence that its endpoints are equivalent.
Cooccurrence only contradicts a strong at-most-one-listed-member-per-whole-inscription rule; it does not contradict contextual substitution or allography.
Short frames can connect many signs and dominate graph density; length-cutoff summaries retain this sensitivity.
No M/P crosswalk, proposed semantic columns, graph clustering or sign merging is used.
Source complete/direction labels and W distinctions remain provisional; photos not individually audited here.
protocol.order: Literal source file order; positions zero-based.
protocol.same_sign_repetition: At least two occurrences of identical W code within one complete text; one witness per sign/text.
protocol.status: Exploratory exhaustive descriptive enumeration; no permutation test or significance claim.
protocol.weight: Number of distinct exact masked frames; not number of repeated objects or a probability.
protocol.weighting: One observation per distinct literal complete text; every associated source record retained in text ledger.

quality_sensitivity.interpretation: Source-condition sensitivity only; rows are filtered before whole-text deduplication. A text survives if at least one source record has an allowed condition. No primary-image validation is implied. Main witness IDs are not reused for this recomputation.
